subtopic: Confirmation and follow-up of elevated blood pressure
stemEn: You are seeing a 12-year-old child with a second reading of high blood pressure taken two weeks after the initial high blood pressure reading. What will you do next?
explanationAr: المصدر يضع Ambulatory BP measurement كمفتاح، لكنه يذكر أن جامعي اختبار 2024 وصفوا القراءتين كـstage 1 HTN؛ في هذه الحالة قد تكون الخطوة التالية إعادة قياس/زيارة ثالثة قبل ABPM حسب التسلسل الإرشادي. لذلك السؤال يحتاج مراجعة لصياغة المرحلة والقراءات الأصلية.
reasoningEn: The source key is ABPM, but the source itself warns that if the recalled readings were stage 1 hypertension, another follow-up office BP measurement may precede ABPM depending on the exact guideline pathway.
incorrectOptionsAr: Renal ultrasound وechocardiography ليستا الخطوة الأولى لمجرد قراءتين مرتفعتين دون تأكيد التشخيص/indication. بدء medication يعتمد على severity, symptoms, persistence وcomorbidities.
clinicalPearl: The exact next step in pediatric hypertension depends on BP category and the number/timing of confirmed readings.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026
sourceRefs.notes: Also recalled 2021. Source itself flags possible conflict if readings were stage 1 HTN.

verification.referenceNotes: High-priority verification against current pediatric BP guideline pathway.

stemEn: A 13-year-old boy known to have hypertension presented with high blood pressure and altered level of consciousness. Stroke was suspected and brain CT showed brain edema. Cardiac examination was normal. What will you give him?
explanationAr: الصورة هي hypertensive emergency مع encephalopathy/end-organ cerebral injury. المصدر يختار IV labetalol، ويذكر أن IV nicardipine خيار مفضل أيضًا حسب العمر والcontraindications. Mannitol لا يعالج السبب الأساسي للـhypertensive encephalopathy.
reasoningEn: Severe symptomatic hypertension with neurologic end-organ injury requires controlled IV blood-pressure reduction; the source keys labetalol.
incorrectOptionsAr: Anticoagulation ليست علاج hypertensive encephalopathy بحد ذاته. Mannitol قد يُستخدم في سياقات محددة لraised ICP لكنه لا يعالج hypertensive emergency ولا يُعطى تلقائيًا لمجرد وجود cerebral edema.
clinicalPearl: In pediatric hypertensive emergencies, lower BP carefully with titratable IV therapy rather than normalizing it abruptly.
managementSteps: Monitor neurologic status and BP closely

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026
sourceRefs.notes: Source explanation cites UpToDate and discusses IV labetalol or nicardipine.

stemEn: A 5-year-old patient known to have asthma complained of headache for several days with diaphoresis, flushing, and vision problems with bilateral papilledema. Blood pressure was 150/110 mmHg, consistent with hypertensive emergency. What is your management?
explanationAr: هذا hypertensive emergency ويحتاج titratable IV therapy. وجود asthma يجعل labetalol أقل ملاءمة بسبب احتمال bronchoconstriction؛ لذلك المصدر يختار IV nicardipine.
reasoningEn: IV nicardipine is the source key because severe symptomatic hypertension needs IV titratable therapy and asthma is a relative contraindication to labetalol.
incorrectOptionsAr: Labetalol قد يسبب bronchoconstriction في asthma. Oral nicardipine لا يناسب hypertensive emergency. Intermittent hydralazine أقل قابلية للtitration مقارنةً بـcontinuous IV nicardipine.
clinicalPearl: Asthma is an important clue when choosing between labetalol and nicardipine in a hypertensive emergency.
